description: In today's climate, dialogue across diverse policy and political affiliations has become increasingly scarce. However, we must make an effort to listen and engage with others respectfully, even when our views differ. It's valuable to understand different perspectives, and if disagreement arises, we should ask probing questions and offer explanations for our beliefs. Through open discussion and dialogue, persuading others to consider alternative viewpoints is possible.
title: Respect One Another | DeCaprio 4 CT 48th
